title: Dad's Meatballs
description: Ground beef meatballs with seasoned breadcrumbs, herbs, a generous helping of Parmesan, and a pan sear before baking and simmering in sauce.
cookTime: Until browned and fully cooked, then simmered in sauce
totalTime: Varies with meatball size and sauce simmer
ingredients: A generous amount of parsley, to taste
About 30 g milk, a large splash (approximate)
About 120 g grated Parmesan, a very generous heaping cup (approximate)
steps: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, egg, seasoned breadcrumbs, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, and a generous amount of parsley. Season with salt and pepper.
Add a large splash of milk and a very generous heaping cup of Parmesan. Mix thoroughly with your hands and form evenly sized meatballs.
Add the avocado oil to a pan. Heat it and brown the meatballs in batches, without crowding the pan.
Transfer the browned meatballs to a pan or baking sheet. Bake at 375°F / 190°C until cooked through.
Simmer the meatballs in your tomato sauce with some of the pan drippings until tender.
notes: Transcribed from Dad's handwritten recipe. The original gives 5 g of each garlic powder, onion powder, and Italian seasoning, but does not weigh the large splash of milk, parsley, or heaping cup of Parmesan. Their gram quantities are estimates. Baking time depends on meatball size.
